record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.original_question: Does every graph G admit a bisection (S, T) such that for every vertex u in S, the number of neighbors of u in T is at least d_S(u) - 1, and for every vertex v in T, the number of neighbors of v in S is at least d_T(v) - 1?

evidence.quote: We complete this section with a wildly open conjecture of Bollob´as and Scott [13].

Conjecture 3.3[13, Conjecture 8] Every graph G admits a bisection (S, S¯) with
|NS¯(u)| ≥ dS(u) − 1 for each u ∈ S,
and
|NS(v)| ≥ dS¯(v) − 1 for each v ∈ S. ¯

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph. A bisection of $G$ is an ordered partition $(S,T)$ of $V$ into two disjoint sets with $\big||S|-|T|\big|\le 1$. For a vertex $u\in V$ and a set $X\subseteq V$, let $d_X(u)$ denote the number of neighbors of $u$ in $X$, and let $N_X(u)$ denote the set of neighbors of $u$ in $X$.

Decide whether the following statement holds: every finite simple graph $G$ admits a bisection $(S,T)$ such that
$$|N_T(u)| \ge d_S(u)-1 \quad \text{for every } u\in S,$$
and
$$|N_S(v)| \ge d_T(v)-1 \quad \text{for every } v\in T.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work indicates that the original conjecture (with additive constant −1) fails for an infinite family of graphs, so the statement as posed is false in general; however, the natural weaker version replacing the constant −1 by an O(1) additive term remains widely open, and special cases (e.g., for various classes of regular graphs) have been established.

status_evidence.title: Bisections of graphs under degree constraints (arXiv:2504.15096)
status_evidence.snippet: The original statement asserting that every vertex v has at least d_G(v)/2 − 1/2 neighbors in its opposite part fails for an infinite family of graphs; the weaker version replacing the constant with O(1) remains widely open.
status_evidence.claim: The exact conjecture is disproved, while the O(1) weakening remains open.

status_evidence.title: Weak External Bisections of Regular Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes weak external bisection results for classes of regular graphs related to the Bollobás–Scott conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress is known for regular graphs.
